items.scope_note: The product boundary is implemented as the controlling launch scope; excluded products and providers cannot satisfy this checklist.

gates.title: Product target and non-goals are unambiguous
criteria: AgentGuard is named as the launch product.
Legacy AadhaarChain, FlatWatch, Solana, production NPCI, and unrelated identity expansion are explicitly outside this launch.
procedure: Review the canonical product thesis and compare its scope with the checklist.
evidence_required: Canonical product thesis with explicit product target and non-goals.

items.scope_note: Frozen contract closure covered deterministic safety, two unchanged-source Buyer passes, two Seller passes, responsive/accessibility smoke, and FQDN/Auth0 acceptance.
not_proven: Production ONDC conformance or go-live approval

Q1 current-source release acceptance is started

gates.title: Deterministic contract and safety suite
criteria: The frozen contract matrix and mandatory safety checks pass.
procedure: Run the retained deterministic portfolio verification against the frozen fingerprint.
evidence_required: Structured CF0 evidence receipt naming the fingerprint and passing checks.

gates.title: Buyer unchanged-source acceptance twice
criteria: Two Buyer journeys pass without changing application source between runs.
procedure: Repeat the mandate-governed Buyer journey twice and compare the frozen source fingerprint.
evidence_required: Two Buyer receipts tied to the retained CF0 fingerprint.

gates.title: Seller unchanged-source acceptance twice
criteria: Two Seller lifecycle and refund journeys pass without changing application source.
procedure: Repeat the Seller protected lifecycle twice against the same frozen source.
evidence_required: Two Seller receipts tied to the retained CF0 fingerprint.

gates.title: Responsive and accessibility acceptance
criteria: Buyer and Seller pass desktop and 390x844 semantic, keyboard, and overflow checks.
procedure: Run the combined rendered smoke at both retained viewport sizes.
evidence_required: Rendered acceptance record covering semantics, dialogs, focus, IDs, and overflow.

gates.title: FQDN and Auth0 acceptance
criteria: Buyer and Seller re-authenticate and reach their protected product surfaces on the public FQDNs.
procedure: Run sequential Buyer and Seller Auth0 acceptance on the retained deployments.
evidence_required: Dated public-surface acceptance evidence for both applications.

items.scope_note: Frozen foundation acceptance covered PostgreSQL ownership, deterministic suites, two complete readback cycles, and public Buyer/Seller acceptance; payment remained simulated.
revalidate_when: Foundation persistence or deployment source changes
Q1 current-source release acceptance is started

gates.title: Durable PostgreSQL ownership and readback
criteria: AgentGuard, CommerceV1, and ONDC use the selected PostgreSQL owner and two full cycles survive readback.
procedure: Run the frozen foundation suite and repeat the complete publish, checkout, payment, refund, and receipt cycle twice.
evidence_required: Structured CF1 receipt containing database state, two-cycle results, and frozen fingerprint.

gates.title: Frozen Buyer and Seller release acceptance
criteria: Buyer and Seller pass deterministic, rendered, responsive, accessibility, and FQDN/Auth0 acceptance on the frozen source.
procedure: Execute the retained local and public acceptance gates without source mutation.
evidence_required: Structured CF1 release receipt naming deployments, commands, rendered checks, and source fingerprint.

items.scope_note: The authenticated portal snapshot is dated 2026-08-10. The direct provider-mail readback on 2026-08-15 corroborates all three profiles as Integration in Progress but does not replace current portal readback or prove production approval.
not_proven: Production identity, conformance, or go-live approval

gates.title: Current ONDC organisation and profile readback
criteria: The portal shows organisation 15462 as GURUSHARAN GUPTA HUF.
The current participant-profile inventory, role, domain, version, and integration status are visible; A2 owns production-scope approval.
procedure: Open the ONDC portal organisation and Integrations profile without submitting changes.
Capture the observation time, exact profile fields, and current status.
evidence_required: Dated redacted portal capture or export showing the organisation and participant profile.
Recorded portal URL or section and observation timestamp.

items.scope_note: A2 approves the initial role/domain matrix only; it does not authorize portal, key, deployment, contract, spending, customer-money, or submission actions.

gates.title: Approved production role and domain matrix
criteria: Buyer NP, Seller NP, or both are explicitly approved.
Every required ONDC domain and every excluded role/domain are recorded with rationale.
The matrix is consistent with the A1 portal readback and scopes A4 and B4-B8 without assumptions.
procedure: Product lead reviews A1 and the intended launch journeys.
Record the dated decision and approver; do not submit portal changes from this gate.
evidence_required: Approved dated role/domain matrix with rationale and approver.

items.scope_note: Completion applies only to the retained PreProd participant-host gate, not production registration.

gates.title: PreProd participant-host gate
criteria: Dedicated PreProd identity, registry readback, site verification, on_subscribe, DNS, and TLS all pass for the same participant endpoint.
procedure: Verify the retained participant identity and independently read back registry, public DNS, TLS, site verification, and callback status.
evidence_required: Dated PreProd matrix and participant-host evidence naming the verified endpoint.

gates.title: Local isolated participant-host foundation
criteria: Buyer NP, Seller NP, and Logistics Buyer NP use distinct subscriber IDs and role-specific key roots.
Each role reports a full callback URL matching its subscriber ID and serves site verification on that host.
Valid encrypted on_subscribe challenges pass and a mismatched subscriber ID fails closed.
procedure: Run the parameterized onboarding test for the three A2-approved roles with ephemeral isolated keys.
Run the focused ONDC adapter and BPP regression set.
evidence_required: Immutable local receipt with source fingerprints, assertions, results, and explicit production exclusions.

gates.title: Production registry identity and key readback
criteria: Registry readback matches the A2 roles, domains, subscriber IDs, callback URLs, and active key IDs.
Recorded public-key fingerprints match the deployed private-key owner without exposing secrets.
procedure: After A2 approval, create isolated production identity and keys only for approved roles/domains.
Read back the authoritative registry record and compare every field to A2.
evidence_required: Redacted registry response, key IDs and fingerprints, observation time, and exact deployed source identity.

gates.title: Public participant-host verification
criteria: Public DNS and TLS resolve to the approved runtime.
Site verification and /ondc/on_subscribe pass against the exact deployed source.
Invalid or mismatched verification requests fail closed.
procedure: Deploy the verified source before publishing DNS.
Probe DNS, TLS, site verification, the challenge route, and negative cases; retain raw results.
evidence_required: Deployment ID and source fingerprint, DNS/TLS results, endpoint responses, and negative-case proof.

items.scope_note: A5-C1 proves listed code controls including a durable Postgres session registry on current source. A5 stays incomplete until operator tenant cutover, tenant MFA/Attack Protection, and release-source security acceptance pass. No production tenant or connection cutover from this receipt.
not_proven: Production Auth0 tenant or connection cutover
Security acceptance on a frozen/release source
revalidate_when: Session, Auth0, or AgentGuard authorization source changes
Q1 current-source release acceptance is started

gates.title: Listed identity code controls on current source
criteria: SESSION_SECRET dual-publish accepts previous then drops it.
Logout, revoke, and revoke-all deny stolen cookies; the deny-list survives gateway restart on PostgreSQL.
GET /api/auth/sessions is principal-scoped.
Buyer/Seller audience isolation and Seller step-up amr=mfa fail closed in staging/production.
procedure: Run focused gateway pytest with PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 and local loopback DATABASE_URL only.
Prove revoke/list durability with an isolated schema and a new connection after unbind.
evidence_required: Immutable receipt naming the pytest command, pass count, local Postgres isolation, and production exclusions.

gates.title: Production Auth0 tenant and connection cutover
criteria: A dedicated production Auth0 tenant and Regular Web Application are the live IdP for gateway.aadharcha.in.
Production callbacks, logout, and web origins match the approved FQDN allowlists.
procedure: Operator executes tenant/connection cutover out of band after explicit authorization.
Read back dashboard allowlists and gateway AUTH0_* on the approved runtime without copying secrets into git.
evidence_required: Operator-authorized tenant cutover receipt with redacted dashboard and runtime readback.

gates.title: Production-tenant MFA and Attack Protection
criteria: Production-tenant MFA is enabled for Seller elevated writes.
Attack Protection (bot, brute-force, breached password) is enabled on the production tenant.
procedure: Operator enables MFA and Attack Protection in the production tenant dashboard.
Confirm gateway still fail-closes Seller refund/catalog publish without session amr=mfa.
evidence_required: Operator-authorized tenant policy readback; no secret material.

gates.title: Security acceptance on the release source
criteria: Each listed A5 control is proved on the frozen/release source used for Q1, not only the working tree.
procedure: Re-run the retained A5 deterministic suite against the release fingerprint.
Do not promote current-source pytest to Q1 acceptance.
evidence_required: Release-source receipt naming the frozen fingerprint and remaining production exclusions.

gates.title: Regulated provider approval and production scope
criteria: A regulated provider is contractually and commercially approved for the A2 launch roles, jurisdictions, payment flows, refunds, settlement, and payouts.
Supported methods, limits, fees, settlement timing, compliance duties, failure ownership, and production activation boundaries are recorded without assumptions.
The provider confirms production certification and go-live eligibility for the approved merchant or participant identity.
procedure: Product and finance owners compare candidate capabilities with A2 and the required customer-money journeys.
Retain the approved scope, contracts, compliance and certification readback; an agent must not select a provider, accept terms, spend, or enable production.
evidence_required: Redacted approval or contract record, certification status, approved identity and environment, capability matrix, commercials, and named business/compliance owners.

gates.title: End-to-end money safety and reconciliation certification
criteria: Payment intent, receipt, and provider records bind the exact order, principal, amount, currency, and authorized action.
Signed webhooks and callbacks pass authentication, freshness, idempotency, replay, duplicate, late, and out-of-order handling.
Success, decline, timeout, partial, unknown, refund, settlement, payout, and recovery paths converge without double effect or unexplained financial variance.
Provider, order, payment, refund, internal ledger, settlement, fee, and payout readbacks reconcile, with an owner for every exception.
procedure: On one frozen source and provider-approved non-production environment, run representative success, failure, duplicate, delayed, refund, and unknown-outcome journeys.
Independently reconcile provider exports and signed callbacks with persisted internal records and customer-visible terminal state.
Retain the provider certification result before any separately authorized production enablement.
evidence_required: Frozen source fingerprint, provider test or certification report, redacted transaction and callback traces, signature results, reconciliation export, refund proof, and exception dispositions.

items.scope_note: Completion is limited to frozen PreProd Retail discovery with one approved Seller item.

gates.title: Signed Retail discovery correlation
criteria: A signed PreProd Retail search receives a correlated, signature-verified on_search containing the approved Seller item and expected price and inventory.
procedure: Send the frozen signed search, poll by transaction ID, verify callback signature/context, and compare the returned item with the approved catalog record.
evidence_required: Gate 1 receipt containing transaction correlation, signature result, Seller item, price, inventory, and source identity.

items.scope_note: Completion applies to the official synthetic Workbench Immediate Delivery flow only.

gates.title: Official Workbench LOG10 forward lifecycle
criteria: All 15 expected Immediate Delivery steps complete with no missed or extra steps, and every callback is signature-verified and ACKed.
procedure: Run one official Workbench LOG10 1.2.5 flow, satisfy each visible input boundary, and correlate every callback and readback through final on_status.
evidence_required: Workbench session and transaction IDs, 15-step record, callback signatures, ACK results, and explicit synthetic-only boundary.

gates.title: External compliant LSP lifecycle
criteria: One external LSP completes signed confirm, update, status, track, cancellation, and exception callbacks with correlation, Buyer/Seller delivery tracking, and terminal state.
Duplicate, stale, skipped, cancelled, invalid-signature, and mismatched callbacks fail or reconcile safely.
procedure: Run the authorized frozen-source LOG10 journey against an external compliant LSP through confirm, update, status, track, cancellation, and exception handling.
Compare signed callbacks, persisted CommerceV1 state, and rendered Buyer/Seller delivery and itinerary tracking.
evidence_required: LSP identity, source fingerprint, signed callback traces, persisted readback, terminal UI, and exception results.

gates.title: Official Retail lifecycle conformance
criteria: Signed ONDC select, init, confirm, fulfilment, status, track, cancellation, return, refund, and settlement callbacks required by the A2 role/domain matrix complete with correlation, persistence, and ACK/NACK behavior.
Cancellation, return, replacement, refund, tracking, timeout, retry, duplicate, late, and out-of-order paths meet the active specification.
procedure: Run the official current-version Retail conformance lane on one frozen source.
Reconcile protocol records with Buyer, Seller, order, inventory, payment, and receipt state.
evidence_required: Official flow report, signed message traces, source fingerprint, state readback, and closed defects.

items.scope_note: B5 completes on preprod/Auth0 signed IGM plus Buyer/Seller-visible outcome; production IGM is A4/B8, not a B5 hang. Nested 27e8faa live: native BPP issue_status follows closed commerce; Buyer/Seller show UUID, owner, SLA, and audit. Workbench issue 8382bcef remains subscriber-scoped/open and is not the Auth0 user’s.

Workbench-mock signed on_confirm POST to the live BAP

gates.title: Local durable issue and remedy foundation
criteria: Only the authenticated order owner can create and read the Buyer issue.
The Seller can acknowledge and propose a remedy, the Buyer can accept it, and durable issue state closes with a verifiable AgentGuard outcome receipt.
procedure: Run the focused local-file lifecycle, authenticated ownership, domain-state-machine, and PostgreSQL two-sided remedy tests.
evidence_required: Passing focused test output naming the exercised issue lifecycle and PostgreSQL receipt verification.

gates.title: Local issue operations and customer readback
criteria: An authenticated Seller can acknowledge an owned issue, assign one responsible owner, and persist measurable response and escalation targets.
The Buyer can reject a proposed remedy and the issue can enter an escalated state without losing its ordered audit history.
Buyer and Seller order details show the same lifecycle state, owner, response target, escalation target, and audit timeline returned by the durable API.
procedure: Run the local-file and PostgreSQL issue lifecycle tests through acknowledgement, remedy rejection, escalation, and terminal closure.
Build both apps and verify the rendered Buyer and Seller issue cards against the persisted API readback.
evidence_required: Passing gateway and app tests, production builds, and Buyer/Seller UI captures tied to the same issue ID and source fingerprint.

gates.title: Local signed Retail IGM request, callback correlation, and failure recovery
criteria: A signed Retail B2C v1.2 IGM issue request uses ONDC:RET10, core_version 1.2.0, and an Authorization header, and binds to an existing local commerce issue.
A signature-verified on_issue callback correlates to that issue audit timeline; invalid or tampered signatures NACK.
Dispatch failure remains retryable on the existing ONDC outbox without a parallel signing or storage contract.
procedure: Run the focused gateway IGM pytest covering signed request, callback correlation, invalid signature, and dispatch failure.
evidence_required: Passing focused pytest output and an immutable receipt naming the exercised IGM paths and production exclusions.

gates.title: Official IGM lifecycle and operations
criteria: A customer grievance or support issue is correlated from creation through signed network callbacks, escalation, resolution, and closure.
The audit history, responsible owner, response target, Buyer/Seller-visible state, and failure recovery agree.
procedure: Create one authorized representative issue and drive it through the applicable IGM lifecycle.
Verify signed callbacks, persistence, SLA/escalation behavior, customer UI, and terminal resolution.
evidence_required: Issue ID, callback trace, audit timeline, UI captures, owner/SLA readback, and terminal result.

gates.title: Payment, settlement, fee, refund, and payout reconciliation
criteria: Order, payment receipt, refund, fee, settlement, and payout records reconcile without unexplained variance.
Duplicate, delayed, failed, partial, and unknown outcomes converge without double effect and have an assigned exception owner.
procedure: After A7 provider approval, run representative success and failure journeys with signed provider callbacks.
Reconcile provider records against orders, payment attempts, refunds, ledger entries, settlements, and payouts.
evidence_required: Redacted provider records, internal ledger export, reconciliation report, exception results, and ownership evidence.

gates.title: Official network observability submission
criteria: Observability keys belong to the approved participant identity and are handled without exposing secrets.
Official PreProd logs are accepted and the retained report has no unresolved launch-critical defect.
procedure: Generate observability keys through the approved portal boundary.
Submit the required logs, retain the official result, and close or explicitly accept every finding.
evidence_required: Redacted key identity/fingerprint, submission identifier, official report, and finding disposition.

gates.title: Current-source Gate 8 release receipt
criteria: All required testing-framework gates pass on one unchanged source fingerprint and named environment, including buyer/seller lifecycle, ONDC callbacks, LSP, grievance/support, money recovery, accessibility, and rollout recovery acceptance.
Buyer and Seller each pass twice, the independent UI/UX and accessibility review has no unresolved P0/P1, and the next full affected review is empty.
No blocking testing-ledger debt remains.
procedure: Freeze the release source and environment after product and external scope are closed.
Run deterministic verification, complete blind Buyer/Seller journeys, specialist gates, and independent re-review without source mutation.
evidence_required: One Gate 8 receipt naming source, environment, commands, campaign manifest, verdicts, evidence, and zero blocking debt.

gates.title: Exact-deployment public Buyer and Seller acceptance
criteria: The public deployment identity matches the Q1 source fingerprint.
Required FQDN health, Auth0, Buyer, Seller, AgentGuard, callback, visual, console, and backend readbacks pass with no unresolved launch blocker.
procedure: Deploy the Q1 source after release approval and record the immutable deployment identity.
Run live probes and the complete public blind journeys; freeze evidence before diagnosis.
evidence_required: Source fingerprint, deployment ID, FQDNs, Auth0 session boundary, probe outputs, mission verdicts, screenshots, and backend readback.

gates.title: Official production conformance and go-live eligibility
criteria: Official conformance covers every role/domain approved in A2 and every required B3-B7 lane.
The portal and network owners show those roles/domains as production go-live eligible with no unresolved mandatory finding.
procedure: Submit only after A4, B3-B7, Q1, C4, and applicable launch controls pass.
Read back the official portal/network decision and reconcile it with the approved scope.
evidence_required: Official report or identifiers, dated portal readback, approved roles/domains, finding disposition, and go-live eligibility.

items.scope_note: Local Auth0 Buyer and Seller acceptance with simulated payment; Q1 and production boundaries remain separate.
not_proven: deployment, DNS, or ONDC production submission
items.revalidate_when: CF2 application source changes or Q1 begins

gates.title: Buyer complete-lifecycle acceptance
criteria: A buyer can discover, compare, buy, track delivery, cancel, return or replace, raise a grievance, and obtain support with persisted state and visible outcomes.
Buyer-visible tracking, remedy, grievance, and support states agree with the correlated order and callback records.
procedure: On one frozen source, run the complete Buyer journey through each applicable terminal and recovery path.
Compare rendered Buyer state with persisted order, delivery, remedy, grievance, and support records.
evidence_required: Source fingerprint, journey traces, persisted readback, Buyer captures, and terminal or recovery results.

items.scope_note: Local Comet Seller complete-lifecycle acceptance with simulated payment; Q1 and production boundaries remain separate.
not_proven: deployment, DNS, or ONDC production submission

gates.title: Seller complete-lifecycle acceptance
criteria: A seller can onboard, manage roles, import/publish catalog, fulfil to SLA, track delivery/itinerary and payment received, settle/refund, and inspect operational analytics.
Seller-visible catalogue, fulfilment, delivery, payment, settlement, and analytics records agree with the persisted source of truth.
procedure: On one frozen source, run seller onboarding, role assignment, catalogue import, fulfilment, tracking, payment receipt, settlement/refund, and analytics readback.
Compare rendered Seller state with persisted catalogue, order, delivery, payment, settlement, and analytics records.
evidence_required: Source fingerprint, journey traces, persisted readback, Seller captures, and terminal or recovery results.

gates.title: Provider-backed payment and recovery reconciliation
criteria: Signed provider webhooks and idempotency controls reconcile payment receipt, order, refund, fee, settlement, and payout records without unexplained variance.
Duplicate, delayed, failed, and unknown-outcome recovery converges without double effect and has an assigned exception owner.
procedure: After A7 provider approval, run representative payment receipt, refund, settlement, payout, duplicate, delayed, failed, and unknown-outcome journeys.
Reconcile provider records and signed callbacks with orders, internal ledger, customer-visible state, and exception ownership.
evidence_required: Provider certification or test report, redacted callback and transaction traces, reconciliation export, recovery results, and exception dispositions.

gates.title: Product-lead go/no-go decision
criteria: Every required product checklist item and every blocking linked acceptance gate is complete or passed.
The launch owner, rollback owner, support coverage, release source, deployment, and external approvals are recorded.
Deferred items remain explicitly outside the launch claim.
procedure: Review the frozen checklist and linked acceptance receipts without promoting partial evidence.
Record the dated go or no-go decision and rationale.
evidence_required: Signed or approved decision record naming the release source, deployment, scope, owners, and retained receipts.
